imports.title: Import center
imports.subtitle: Bring your whole school in from the spreadsheets you already have. Every file is checked row by row before anything is saved.

order.title: Recommended order
order.body: Each step uses what the one before it created: classes need their teachers and students, and subject choices need the students. You can come back and re-import any file; matching rows are updated, not duplicated.

staff.title: Staff
staff.body: Teachers and other staff with their roles, department, job title and the subjects they teach. They appear in the staff list and in class and timetable pickers straight away, before they accept an invitation.
staff.hint: People are matched by email. Re-importing updates names, job titles, departments and grades, and adds new roles and subjects. It never removes a role; change roles on the People page. Roles that open safeguarding, wellbeing, medical or identity records need the Roles and access permission.

students.title: Students and guardians
students.body: One row per student with their parent or guardian. Brothers and sisters are linked to the same guardian by email.
students.hint: Students are matched by student number. Emirates ID and passport numbers are stored encrypted.

classes.title: Classes and enrollments
classes.body: Classes for the current academic year with their subject, teacher and room, then which students are in each class. You can list students in the classes file or send a separate enrollments file.
classes.hint: Classes are matched by your class code. A class that already exists with the same grade, subject and section is updated instead of copied. Adding a student moves them out of another section of the same subject.
classes.enrollmentsHint: One row per student and class, using the class codes from your classes file.

registrations.title: Subject choices
registrations.body: Which option subjects each student takes, one column per subject marked with x. Students are then placed in class sections automatically.
registrations.hint: Core subjects are registered for everyone, so the file only needs the options.

registrations.noOptions: Set up option subjects on Subject registration first.
